pages.name: Home
pages.description: Signed-in landing page that shows each person the next thing to do for their role.

uses.Caterer Manager: start a new post and see their open listings
uses.NGO / Shelter / Community Kitchen Coordi: see incoming offers waiting for a reply

pages.name: Login
pages.description: Sign-in screen where people enter the app, including the role switcher used in the demo. Also on this screen: Add a Forgot password link that calls POST /api/auth/forgot-password and shows the same confirmation whether or not the account exists.

uses.CSR Sponsor: sign in to see the dashboard
uses.Internal Platform Admin: sign in to run admin tasks

pages.name: Sign Up
pages.description: Open sign-up where people create their own account to use Annadaan. Also on this screen: On Caterer sign-up, after POST /api/auth/register, call POST /api/my/donors with name, zone and contact so the donor business is created unverified. Also on this screen: Send zone and contact with POST /api/auth/register so they are stored on the user; POST /api/auth/register must accept them.

pages.name: Profile
pages.description: Where a person sees and changes their own details, enters a licence number and signs out. Also on this screen: Add a Change password section that calls POST /api/auth/change-password after the current password is checked. Also on this screen: Add zone and contact fields to Personal details, saved through PATCH /api/auth/me, which must accept them. Also on this screen: For a receiver coordinator, show the linked receiver organisation's registration number, verification status and expiry (read only), loaded from GET /api/my/receivers.

uses.Caterer Manager: enter FSSAI number and see the verified badge; sign out
uses.NGO / Shelter / Community Kitchen Coordi: check own details and FSSAI status; sign out
uses.Volunteer Driver: update availability and vehicle; sign out

pages.name: Users
pages.description: Where accounts are added and invited, roles are given, and accounts are deactivated. Also on this screen: Add Receivers, Volunteers and Donors sections listing them from GET /api/admin/receivers, GET /api/admin/volunteers and GET /api/admin/donors, with edit through the PATCH endpoints and deactivate or reactivate through is_active. Also on this screen: Add a Reactivate action on deactivated accounts that calls POST /api/admin/users/{userId}/reactivate.

uses.Internal Platform Admin: add receivers and volunteers, give roles, deactivate accounts

pages.name: Listings
pages.description: List of surplus food listings with their status and consume-by time.

uses.Caterer Manager: see own posts and their status; open one to act on it
uses.Internal Platform Admin: see all listings and filter for flagged ones

pages.name: Listing Detail
pages.description: One listing with its handling card, live status, donation record and the donor's actions. Also on this screen: When a volunteer is assigned, show the one-time handover code to the donor, returned by GET /api/my/listings/{listingId} in its offer summary, with a note to give it to the volunteer at collection. Also on this screen: Show Cancel listing also when the listing is claimed, with a warning that the volunteer is stood down and the receiver is told, calling POST /api/my/listings/{listingId}/cancel. Also on this screen: Add an Edit action while the listing is posted and unclaimed, letting the donor change pickup-by time, storage, pickup point and items through PATCH /api/my/listings/{listingId} and the item endpoints. Also on this screen: For the admin, add a Flag listing action with a reason that calls POST /api/listings/{listingId}/flag-reviews. Also on this screen: For the platform admin, add a Flag listing action with a reason that calls POST /api/listings/{listingId}/flag-reviews, then shows the flag in the Admin flags panel. Also on this screen: In the Admin flags panel, add a Raise flag form (reason and details) that calls POST /api/listings/{listingId}/flag-reviews and shows the new flag. Also on this screen: While the listing is posted and not yet claimed, let the donor edit pickup-by time, storage and items, saving through PATCH /api/my/listings/{listingId} and the items endpoints (POST, PATCH, DELETE /api/my/listings/{listingId}/items). Also on this screen: In the admin flags panel, add a Flag listing action with a reason that calls POST /api/listings/{listingId}/flag-reviews and shows the flag with its time. Also on this screen: In the admin flags panel, add a Flag listing action with a reason that calls POST /api/listings/{listingId}/flag-reviews and shows the flag.

uses.Caterer Manager: read the handling card, follow status, cancel while Posted, download the donation record
uses.Internal Platform Admin: review the listing's details and flags

pages.name: Listing Confirmation
pages.description: Confirmation screen where the donor checks each AI-filled field against the original text before the listing is posted. Also on this screen: Add editable zone and allergen fields that save through PATCH /api/my/listings/{listingId}, which must accept zone and allergens, with allergens still defaulting to 'unknown — ask donor'.

uses.Caterer Manager: check AI-filled fields against the original text, correct them, confirm before posting

pages.name: Donor Post
pages.description: Form and free-text entry where a donor posts what food, how much and the pickup-by time in under a minute.

uses.Caterer Manager: type or speak the surplus, or fill the 3-field form, then submit

pages.name: Offers
pages.description: Ranked offers of surplus food sent to a receiver, each with the reason it was chosen. Also on this screen: Add a Decline control on each offer card that calls POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/decline. Also on this screen: Add a Reported problems section listing the receiver's flags with status and admin decision, from GET /api/my/flag-reviews. Also on this screen: The Decline control on each offer card opens an optional reason field, and submitting calls POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/decline with that reason.

uses.NGO / Shelter / Community Kitchen Coordi: review ranked offers and their reasons; open one to accept

pages.name: Offer Detail
pages.description: One offer with its handling card, accept action, volunteer ETA and delivery confirmation. Also on this screen: After accepting, add a Cancel my claim action that calls POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/cancel and shows that the next match is offered if time allows. Also on this screen: Show the recorded food temperature, storage type and an out-of-range warning, returned by GET /api/my/offers/{offerId}, with the receiver's choice to accept or reject. Also on this screen: Add a Decline action with an optional reason that calls POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/decline and shows the next match if one is offered. Also on this screen: Add a servings received input to the Delivery confirmation section, saved through POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/confirm-delivery. Also on this screen: The out-of-range temperature warning gets accept and reject buttons that call POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/temperature-decision and show the saved decision. Also on this screen: Show the donor's name, zone and FSSAI-verified donor badge, loaded from GET /api/donors/{donorId}. Also on this screen: When the recorded temperature is out of range, show the warning with Accept and Reject buttons that call POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/temperature-decision, then show the logged decision. Also on this screen: When the recorded temperature is out of range, show Accept and Reject buttons that call POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/temperature-decision and display the logged decision and its time. Also on this screen: When the food temperature is out of range, show Accept and Reject buttons that call POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/temperature-decision, and display the saved decision with its time from offers.temperature_decided_at. Also on this screen: When the food temperature is out of range, show accept and reject buttons that call POST /api/my/offers/{offerId}/temperature-decision and show the logged decision.

uses.NGO / Shelter / Community Kitchen Coordi: read handling card and allergens; accept the offer; confirm servings received; flag a mismatch or report the donor

pages.name: Pickups
pages.description: List of pickups assigned to a volunteer, sorted by nearness and time.

uses.Volunteer Driver: see nearby pickups assigned to them; open one to collect

pages.name: Pickup Detail
pages.description: One pickup showing the exact pickup point, the handover code entry and status updates. Also on this screen: Show the donor's masked contact on the pickup summary, returned by GET /api/my/pickups/{pickupId} along with the donor name. Also on this screen: Make the Mark handed over button call POST /api/my/pickups/{pickupId}/handed-over and show that the receiver confirms delivery next. Also on this screen: Show the receiving organisation's name, zone and need level for the drop-off, loaded from GET /api/receivers/{receiverId}.

uses.Volunteer Driver: see the exact pickup point; enter the donor's handover code; update status to collected and delivered

pages.name: Live Status Board
pages.description: Live board showing each listing's status for all parties, with every change logged.

uses.Caterer Manager: follow listing status through to Delivered
uses.NGO / Shelter / Community Kitchen Coordi: see what is coming and its status
uses.Internal Platform Admin: monitor status changes across the platform

pages.name: Impact
pages.description: Impact of each rescue, with meals, kg and CO2e, each number's stated assumption and the assumption version used. Also on this screen: Add a Download delivery records action per rescue that calls GET /api/impact-records/{impactRecordId}/donation-record. Also on this screen: Add a panel listing the published assumption versions from GET /api/assumption-sets (kg per meal, emission factor, rule-table version) and the rule-table rows from GET /api/rule-tables that the consume-by deadline uses.

uses.CSR Sponsor: review each rescue's impact and its assumptions and version

pages.name: Weekly Impact Report
pages.description: Weekly report for a donor showing their delivered rescues' meals, kg and CO2e with the assumptions used.

uses.Caterer Manager: read the weekly impact report and share it with clients

pages.name: Sponsor Dashboard
pages.description: Dashboard of impact totals by zone and per week, with quarterly summaries for sponsored zones.

uses.CSR Sponsor: view impact totals by zone and review quarterly summaries for sponsored zones

pages.name: FSSAI Verification
pages.description: Screen where donor and receiver FSSAI licence or registration numbers are verified and their expiry is tracked.

uses.Internal Platform Admin: verify FSSAI numbers for donors and receivers; watch expiry dates

pages.name: Flag Review
pages.description: Queue of flagged listings and locked handovers waiting for an admin decision. Also on this screen: Add a Guardrail breaches tab listing rejected and invalid intake calls from GET /api/admin/agent-calls, with the banned claim or injected instruction shown and an action to mark it reviewed. Also on this screen: Add an ETA at risk tab listing offers whose volunteer ETA is later than the deadline minus 15 minutes, with a Reassign action that calls POST /api/admin/offers/{offerId}/reassign-volunteer. Also on this screen: In the decision panel, add a Deactivate account action for the listing's donor owner that calls POST /api/admin/users/{userId}/deactivate. Also on this screen: The ETA at risk tab lists offers from GET /api/admin/offers/at-risk, and each row has a Reassign action calling POST /api/admin/offers/{offerId}/reassign-volunteer. Also on this screen: On each row of the ETA at risk tab, add a Reassign action that calls POST /api/admin/offers/{offerId}/reassign-volunteer to assign an available volunteer or record a receiver collection or donor drop-off. Also on this screen: In the ETA at risk tab, add a Reassign volunteer action per offer that calls POST /api/admin/offers/{offerId}/reassign-volunteer and shows the logged status event.

uses.Internal Platform Admin: review flagged listings and locked handovers and decide on each

pages.name: Assumptions
pages.description: Screen to edit assumption values and rule tables, each change versioned.

uses.Internal Platform Admin: edit kg per meal, emission factor and rule tables; publish a new version

pages.name: Internal Metrics
pages.description: Internal page showing the funnel events and section 4 metrics computed from them. Also on this screen: Show each receiver's share of offers sent over the chosen period, from GET /api/admin/internal-metrics. Also on this screen: Switching to the weekly snapshot and choosing a week calls GET /api/admin/internal-metrics/weekly and shows its figures beside the live ones. Also on this screen: Add a period picker and a per-receiver share table, read from GET /api/admin/offer-share-by-receiver.

uses.Internal Platform Admin: review funnel events and success metrics

pages.name: Usage
pages.description: Page showing token usage and cost, with the 70% budget alert.

uses.Internal Platform Admin: check daily token usage against the budget alert

pages.name: Reset Password
pages.description: Sets a new password from the emailed link using POST /api/auth/reset-password, rejecting expired or reused links; also how newly added users set their first password.
